# Michelle Traudt Counseling

Michelle Traudt is a Licensed Professional Counselor Associate in Austin, Texas. She works with individuals and couples navigating anxiety, depression, relational issues, life transitions, and post-abortion healing. Christian faith integration is available upon request.

Website: https://michelletraudt.com/
Practice location: New Life Counseling Center Southwest Location, 3355 Bee Caves Road, #101, Austin, Texas 78746
Appointment email: hope@newlifecounselingcenter.com
Role: Licensed Professional Counselor Associate
Education: MA in Counseling from Dallas Theological Seminary; BS in Merchandising from Texas Tech University
Professional membership: Christian Counselors of Texas

Primary services:
- Individual counseling for anxiety, depression, relational issues, and life transitions
- Couples and marriage counseling
- Post-abortion healing
- Faith-based Christian counseling upon request

Canonical page:
